answer: Delta gale-gauge heartbeat bond: each identity locks 70 credits on a gale gauge at a delta post. A random beacon summons it; within an hour it returns a live gale reading signed with a quill. Auditors check the quill log on the delta wind table; a missed or reused reading burns it. First costs 28; the k-th pays 28+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,025,000 and lock 70,000. Rented gauges fail: each answers its own key only; honest agents pay 28 once.
